checklist: cert/checklist.mjs (1.17.0-9, homescoop#470), users enforce, as root: the realm's wasix-autoconf (needsInstall) is the version the tarball depends on (2.72.0-8 since 1.17.0-10, 2.72.0-10 since 1.17.0-12); on a PATH of links to every realm command but grep, sed and awk, automake --version and aclocal --version print 1.17, and aclocal && autoconf && automake --add-missing on a two-line configure.ac / Makefile.am write Makefile.in (VERSION = @VERSION@) and install install-sh and missing, with no error; with wasm-grep, wasm-sed and wasm-gawk, sh ./configure writes a Makefile with VERSION = 1.0
1.17.0-8 pins wasix-autoconf 2.72.0-6 (autom4te's probe needs grep), so its first check fails; with 2.72.0-6 in the realm, aclocal without grep fails with 'need GNU m4 1.4 or later: m4' (NEGATIVE.md)
1.17.0-10 (packaging-only, homescoop#634): the same checklist.mjs on the wasix-autoconf (2.72.0-8) and wasix-perl (5.42.0-13) it now pins, so an install of both packages has one perl

one perl (homescoop#656): cert/checklist.mjs checks that the tarball's @ai-ecoverse/wasix-perl pin equals the pinned wasix-autoconf's wasix-perl dependency and the realm's wasix-perl (needsInstall), so the skew 1.17.0-9 had (5.42.0-11 beside autoconf's 5.42.0-13, two perls in node_modules) fails the cert

cert/paths.mjs (1.17.0-13, homescoop#909): bin/automake, automake-1.17, aclocal and aclocal-1.17 name /bin/sh in the DJGPP $ENV{'SHELL'} line and carry no build-host path (/bin/bash, /home/runner, homescoop-work, .homescoop-out, /Users/, /opt/homebrew); build.sh runs configure with CONFIG_SHELL=/bin/sh SHELL=/bin/sh, so every host writes the same bytes (1.17.0-12, built on ubuntu, names /bin/bash: NEGATIVE.md)
